Overview

Concordia is a city in Entre Ríos with a population of 170,000. Entre Ríos’ second city on the Uruguay River, famous for its citrus production and thermal springs. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
